Welcome to the world of insurance! Initially, it may seem dark, ugly, hopeless, deadly, menacing, leaving a deep mark, but in this darkness, another side can be traced: brighter, kinder, forcing you to finally show yourself. After all, this world is a Man. A living, sensual and different Man, who can hide himself and his feelings in various fears and vices. A Man is born, fears surround him, they think, creating problems, eternal throwing. A Man grows, does not quite understand how to do it right, what is right and whether it exists - it gets bumps, tries to load itself into fears that have already been absorbed under the casing as much as possible. At this moment, they hold us, not allowing decline. A Man accepts you, understands that he can "be friends" with them, realize, cherish and be attentive. Fears save us and show us the way. A Man accepts himself, his life, his fears, and knows how to live with them. Liberation and formation occur. These four stages are shown through a modern canvas and a homage to the Renaissance. Then, in the story, each fear in this world will gradually be revealed.

The project "Revival of Insurance", born in the darkest period and based on the analysis of natural insurance. Being in a difficult emotional state every day, I thought about the root cause and motivation to "suffer". Everything that previously forced me to overcome difficulties and reach new heights ceased to work. I began to tactilely feel and see the fears that surrounded society.
